36415.commentary: (NIDD1) gāme ca nābhisajjeyyā'ti. kathaṃ gāme sajjati? idha bhikkhu gāme gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandī sahasokī sukhitesu sukhito dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā voyogaṃ āpajjati. evam'pi gāme sajjati… atha vā bhikkhu pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati rakkhiteneva kāyena rakkhitāya vācāya rakkhitena cittena upaṭṭhitāya satiyā saṃvutehi indriyehi. so tatra tatra na sajjati tatra tatra na gaṇhāti tatra tatra na bajjhati tatra tatra na anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati. evam'pi gāme na sajjati. gāme ca nābhisajjeyyā'ti gāme na sajjeyya na gaṇheyya na bajjheyya na palibajjheyya, agiddho assa agadhito amucchito anajjhosanno vītagedho vigatagedho cattagedho… brahmabhūtena attanā vihareyyā'ti, gāme ca n'ābhisajjeyya. (SNPa) gāme ca nābhisajjeyyā'ti gāme ca gihisaṃsagg'ādīhi n'ābhisajjeyya.

examples.text: kayavikkaye na tiṭṭheyya, upavādaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci, gāme ca n'ābhisajjeyya, lābhakamyā janaṃ na lapayeyya.

examples.text: saḷāyatanañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? saḷāyatanaṃ nāmarūpanidānaṃ nāmarūpasamudayaṃ nāmarūpajātikaṃ nāmarūpapabhavaṃ.

examples.text: tāsaṃ ce, āvuso, naḷakalāpīnaṃ ekaṃ ākaḍḍheyya, ekā papateyya, aparaṃ ce ākaḍḍheyya, aparā papateyya. evam'eva kho, āvuso, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho
nāmarūpasamudayā viññāṇasamudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho.

36461.meaning1: leading to the ending of names and forms; leading to the cessation of mental and physical phenomena

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako nāmarūpañ'ca pajānāti, nāmarūpasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, nāmarūpanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, nāmarūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

36462.meaning1: fact of having arisen dependent on name and form

36463.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of nāmarūpapaccaya
36463.meaning1: dependent on mind and body; due to mental and physical phenomena
36463.meaningLit: from condition of name and form

examples.text: nāmarūpapaccayā phasso'ti iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ, tadānanda, iminā'p'etaṃ pariyāyena veditabbaṃ, yathā nāmarūpapaccayā
avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā

36464.meaning1: produced by name and form; generated by materiality and mentality

examples.text: saḷāyatanañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? saḷāyatanaṃ nāmarūpanidānaṃ nāmarūpasamudayaṃ nāmarūpajātikaṃ nāmarūpapabhavaṃ.

36465.meaning1: source of name and form; origination of mental and physical phenomena
36465.commentary: (MNa) nāmarūpasamudayā'ti ettha pana yaṃ nāmaṃ yañ'ca rūpaṃ, yañ'ca nāmarūpaṃ yassa āyatanassa paccayo hoti, tassa vasena visuddhimagge paṭiccasamuppādaniddese vuttanayena nāmarūpasamudayā saḷāyatanasamudayo veditabbo.

examples.text: nāmarūpasamudayā viññāṇasamudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho.
nāmarūpasamudayā cittassa samudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā cittassa atthaṅ'gamo. manasikārasamudayā dhammānaṃ samudayo, manasikāranirodhā dhammānaṃ atthaṅ'gamo'ti.

36466.meaning1: with name and form as source; originating from the six sense fields
36466.commentary: (MNa) nāmarūpasamudayā'ti ettha pana yaṃ nāmaṃ yañ'ca rūpaṃ, yañ'ca nāmarūpaṃ yassa āyatanassa paccayo hoti, tassa vasena visuddhimagge paṭiccasamuppādaniddese vuttanayena nāmarūpasamudayā saḷāyatanasamudayo veditabbo.

examples.text: saḷāyatanañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? saḷāyatanaṃ nāmarūpanidānaṃ nāmarūpasamudayaṃ nāmarūpajātikaṃ nāmarūpapabhavaṃ.

36468.meaning2: by means of name and form

36469.meaning2: definition of name-and-form, distinguishing of mentality-materiality

36470.meaning1: with name and form as precondition

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

36471.commentary: (VINa) nāmaleso nāma saṅgharakkhito diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto. aññaṃ saṅgharakkhitaṃ passitvā codeti, saṅgharakkhito mayā diṭṭho.

examples.text: kiñci desaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāyā'ti leso nāma dasa lesā, jātileso, nāmaleso, gottaleso, liṅgaleso, āpattileso, pattaleso, cīvaraleso, upajjhāyaleso, ācariyaleso, sen'āsanaleso.

36472.meaning1: based on names; dependent on words
36472.commentary: (SNa) nāmasannissitā'ti samudd'ādipaṇṇattinissitā. gāthā ārabhanto hi samuddaṃ vā pathaviṃ vā yaṃ kiñci nāmaṃ nissayitvā'va ārabhati.

examples.text: chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, nāmasannissitā gāthā, kavi gāthānam'āsayo'ti.

36475.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of nāma
36475.meaning1: by name; having the name of

examples.text: gandhabbānaṃ adhipati, dhataraṭṭho'ti nāmaso, ramatī naccagītehi, gandhabbehi purakkhato.
439, 539. dhāturūpe nāmasmā ṇayo ca.
tassa evaṃ hoti, ucchijjissāmi nāmassu, vinassissāmi nāmassu, nassu nāma bhavissāmī'ti

36479.meaning2: names, mentions or addresses by name

examples.text: ko nām'āyaṃ, subhūti, bhikkhū'ti? saddho nām'āyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu, sudattassa upāsakassa putto, saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito'ti.
kudāssu nām'āhaṃ tadāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yadariyā eta'r'ahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantī'ti iti anuttaresu vimokkhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihapaccayā domanassaṃ.
desetu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ, desetu sugato saṃkhittena dhammaṃ, app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ. app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāy'ādo assan'ti.
kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kām'ūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. api ca kho, bhikkhave, n'ete kāmā kāmaguṇā nām'ete ariyassa vinaye vuccanti. saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo.

36487.meaning1: having caused to bend; having bent someone over

examples.text: gahapatiko rathā otaritvā kesesu gahetvā nāmetvā kapparapahārehi koṭṭetvā gale gahetvā āgatamaggābhimukhaṃ khipitvā pakkāmi
atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, icchām'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisallīyituṃ. n'āmhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā'ti.

36491.synonym: adhipati, adhibhū, ina, issara, pati, bhattar

examples.text: bhavanā abhinikkhamma, addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ, indīvaraṃ'va jalitaṃ, ādittaṃ'va hut'āsanaṃ.
so na labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni, na labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni, na labheyya patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ, na labheyya gām'antanāyakaṃ.

36494.meaning1: is known; is evident; is perceived

examples.text: ñā'icc'etassa dhātussa jā jaṃ nā'ādesā honti vā. jānāti, jāneyya, jāniyā, jaññā, nāyati.
ñā'icc'etāya dhātuyā parassa nāpaccayassa lopo hoti vā, yakārattañ'ca. jaññā, nāyati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? jānāti.

idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ kho ayam'āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī, na santatakārī na santatavutti, sīlesu dussīlo ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā sīlavā'ti.
tam'enaṃ samannesamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ samāpanno ayam'āyasmā imaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, n'āyam'āyasmā ittarasamāpanno'ti.

36496.meaning1: not this; not this person; not this thing; this does not; this is not

examples.text: tassa evam'assa, ayaṃ kho gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno, n'āyaṃ sukaro pasayha jīvitā voropetuṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ anupakhajja jīvitā voropeyyan'ti
nippapañc'ārāmass'āyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino n'āyaṃ dhammo papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti
atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api n'āyaṃ ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo usmīkato'pi imasmiṃ dhammavinaye'ti? kiñ'hi siyā, bhante, no h'etaṃ, bhante'ti.

36499.grammar: pr, from na āyūhati, neg, intrans
36499.meaning1: does not strive; does not strain; does not make an effort
36499.construction:
na + ā + yūha + ti
na + āyūhati

examples.text: evaṃ vicāro vitakke appeti, vicāro cariyati ca anuvattati ca. yathā pakkhī pubbaṃ āyūhati pacchā n'āyūhati yathā āyūhanā evaṃ vitakko, yathā pakkhānaṃ pasāraṇaṃ evaṃ vicāro anupālati vitakketi vicarati vicāreti.
nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti apaccayanibbānassa sacchikaraṇ'atthāya. navañ'ca kammaṃ na karotī'ti navaṃ kammaṃ n'āyūhati. purāṇañ'ca kamman'ti pubbe āyūhitakammaṃ.
